segment.source: $(context.player.Name), I just want to thank you so much for helping me back there. Not many are as kind as you and Aliza are. Take care.<end>

segment.source: Why are you torturing me like this? I said I won't try to run.<end>

segment.source: What!?<end>

segment.target: Hold it right there, criminal scum! So, you're the one who's been stealing the medical supplies.<end>

segment.source: ::The man drops on his knees and begs with a whisper.:: Please, man, don't report me. I ain't a bad man, come on. I've been doing this 'cause I had to. I meant no harm.<end>
segment.target: ::The man drops on his knees and begs with a whisper.:: Please, man, don't report me. I ain't a bad man, come on. I've been doing this 'cause I had to. I meant no harm.<end>

segment.source: I hope you have a very good explanation for this.<end>

segment.source: Please - listen. I only needed the painkillers, you see, I... I have an addiction. I got shot several months ago by some lousy Ironhead. Doctor Boudreau treated me back then, and I got addicted to those freaking painkillers. I needed them, man, I couldn't do without them, and I knew she wouldn't give them to me anymore. You have to understand me, man.<end>
